# Portfolio

Welcome to the repository for my portfolio site! I decided to make my code public to showcase my most up-to-date
development processes and overall coding discipline.

I have built this site by hand using [Pug](https://pugjs.org/) and [Prepros](https://prepros.io/) as my tools of choice,
with an emphasis on accessibility and progressive enhancement. 

You can find the live site here: https://rdezwart.ca/
